title: Show kernel drivers for PCI devices
summary: Use lspci with the -k flag to see which kernel drivers and modules are currently handling each PCI device. This helps identify if a device is working correctly or needs a specific driver.

steps.explain: Run lspci with the -k flag to list each PCI device along with the kernel driver currently bound to it.
steps.expect: A list of devices, each followed by lines showing 'Kernel driver in use:' and 'Kernel modules:'
